name: Open-Loop / Closed-Loop Feedback Reclosure
description: When SCR is not conjunctive, the open-loop system Z& is the resultant of (VSCR, ∅), the feedback recipe SCR$ is pure feedback, and the closed-loop systems Z@ and Z@$ agree on product state and external I/O.

elements.text: Open-loop port types for Z& (tagged union of component ports).
Conjunctive coupling recipe (VSCR, ∅) for the same component vector.
Singleton connectable vector whose component is the open-loop system Z&.
CSCR$: relabeled original connections onto open-loop ports.
Z& is the resultant of the conjunctive coupling recipe (VSCR, ∅).
SCR$ is a pure feedback coupling recipe.
Closed-loop equality Z@ = Z@$ on shared product state and external I/O (next-state and readout on unconnected ports).
Theorem 3.64 for non-conjunctive recipes: conjunctive open-loop membership, pure feedback SCR$, and closed-loop equality.
